√mṛś 'touch, feel'
present: [6.] mṛśáti etc. V.+ mṛśáte etc. V.+ 
perfect: mamarśa mamṛśus E.+ māmṛśús mamṛśe B.+ 
aorist: [4.] amārkṣīt amrākṣīt mṛkṣīṣṭa? -- [7.] ámṛkṣat etc. 
[future: markṣyati mrakṣyati marṣṭā mraṣṭā ]
verbal: mṛṣṭá V.+ mṛśita marṣṭum E.+ -mṛ́śya V.+ -mṛ́śe -márśam 
secondary: passive: mṛśyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: mármrśat etc. marīmṛśya- -- causative: marśayati etc. B.+ 
derivatives: -mṛśa B.+ -mṛśya B.+ marśa B.+ -marśaka E. -marśin U.+ máśana V.+ marīmṛśá AV.

√mṛṣ 'not heed'

perfect: mamárṣa mamṛṣe 
aorist: [1.] mṛṣṭhās -- [2.] amṛṣan mṛṣat mṛṣant? mṛṣanta -- [3.] mīmṛṣas amamarṣat -- [5.] amarṣīt marṣiṣṭhās 
[future: marṣiṣyati marṣiṣyate marṣitā ]
verbal: mṛṣita mṛṣitvā marṣitvā -mṛṣya -mṛ́ṣe 
secondary: passive: mṛṣyate -- intensive: māmṛṣat -- causative: marṣayati etc. E.+ marṣayate etc. E.+ 
derivatives: mṛ́ṣā V.+ -mṛṣya RV. -márṣa V.+ marṣin E.+ marṣaṇa E.+ marṣaṇīya E.+ -marṣi E.
